socket.socket.connect_ex = denied
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'C:\\Anthony Siljeg\\draft_releases_20261029\\v09_r3_helpers\\powershell-probes-5_22eef0\\valid\\QPathformer_v0.9_Code\\payload\\study\\quantum')
import numpy as np, scipy, circuits, models, routers, reference_v03
x=np.array([[0.0,0.0],[0.1,-0.3]],dtype=np.float64)
bank=np.zeros((2,2,2),dtype=np.float64)
moments=circuits.moments(x,bank,count=5)
if moments.shape != (2,5) or not np.isfinite(moments).all(): raise ValueError('Invalid moment shape or values')
if not np.all(np.abs(moments)<=1+1e-12): raise ValueError('Moment range failed')
values=np.array([-1.,0.,1.])
if not np.allclose(models.sigmoid(values),1/(1+np.exp(-values)),rtol=1e-14,atol=1e-14): raise ValueError('Sigmoid comparison failed')
print(json.dumps({'numpy_version': np.__version__, 'scipy_version': scipy.__version__, 'numerical_input_records': 2}))
